title: verify
description: Check a time you worked out yourself against the phrase the user wrote, before acting on it. ok is true when the value fits the phrase; otherwise expected holds what the phrase means. The app fixes the zone and the current time. You don't need it for a value {parse} gave you.

text.description: The phrase as the user wrote it

context.description: Which way a phrase that could point either way points: "friday" is the next one (future, the default) or the last one (past)
